name: MimicPC
description_en:
MimicPC hosts preinstalled AI applications such as ComfyUI, image interfaces, model-training tools and audio utilities. Users can work with workflows and custom models without first setting up a local GPU environment.

It is closer to rented AI compute and application hosting than a single text-to-image generator. The hosted platform, each application, each model and uploaded training material have separate operational and licensing considerations.
description_zh:
MimicPC 托管 ComfyUI、图片界面、模型训练及音频等预装应用，可用流程及自定义模型，免先配置本地 GPU。

它更接近 AI 算力及应用租用，而非单一文生图。托管平台、各应用/模型及训练材料分别涉及运维与许可。

core_features.explanation_en: Launch preinstalled tools and configurable workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 启动预装工具及可配流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload models/extensions or use listed LoRA training tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传模型/扩展或用所列 LoRA 工具。

en: Run a small documented image workflow before renting longer training capacity.
zh: 长租训练前先运行小型有记录图片流程。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose hardware and licensed model, record dependencies, test a small render and verify stop/export behavior.
steps.zh: 选硬件及合许可模型，记录依赖，小渲染并核停止/导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: GPU hourly usage funded by credits; optional monthly credit/storage plans.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: $0.50 trial credit; Essential $6.98 promo/$13.95 with $12 monthly credit, Advanced $13.48/$26.95 with $25. Hourly hardware rates separate; orders nonrefundable. Renewal, expiry and idle billing need confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: $0.50 试用额；Essential 促 $6.98/常显 $13.95 含月 $12 额，Advanced $13.48/$26.95 含 $25。硬件小时费另算，订单不退，续费/到期/空闲计费待核。

sources.title: MimicPC - Open-Source AI Platform, Customizable & Affordable
sources.research_notes_en: Hosted preinstalled AI applications, customizable models/nodes and LoRA training; open-source component branding does not license hosted platform.

sources.title: MimicPC Pricing | Affordable AI Platform with Flexible Plans
sources.research_notes_en: $0.50 trial credit, monthly credit/storage plans, hardware hourly rates and nonrefundable orders.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Treat a workflow as software with dependencies
sections.title_zh: 把流程视为有依赖的软件
sections.en: For an illustrative product-style experiment, record the application, workflow, model version and required custom nodes. Test a small render before a training run. Missing extensions, incompatible model weights or insufficient VRAM can change results independently of the prompt. Keep workflow files and original assets outside the rented session.
sections.zh: 例如商品风格实验，记录应用、流程、模型版本及节点，训练前先小渲染。缺扩展、权重不兼容或显存不足都能独立于提示改变结果，应在租用会话外保留流程及原素材。

sections.title_en: Budget hardware time rather than images alone
sections.title_zh: 按硬件时间而非仅图片预算
sections.en: Instant hourly rates are Medium $0.65, Large $1.29, Large-pro $1.59 and Ultra $2.59, with bargain rates $0.38/$0.79/$0.89/$1.59. Hardware/VRAM differ across tiers, so a benchmark speed claim does not give a guaranteed per-image cost. Check startup, idle, interrupted and stopped-session charging and bargain availability before a long job.
sections.zh: 即时小时价 Medium $0.65、Large $1.29、Large-pro $1.59、Ultra $2.59；优惠价 $0.38/$0.79/$0.89/$1.59。硬件显存不同，基准速度不保证单图成本，长任务前需核启动、空闲、中断、停止计费及优惠可用。

sections.title_en: Separate promotional payment from monthly credit value
sections.title_zh: 分开促销付款和月额度价值
sections.en: Starter advertises $0.50 trial credit and 50GB private storage, not ongoing free GPU time. Essential displays $6.98/$13.95 with $12 monthly credit; Advanced $13.48/$26.95 with $25. The page marks first-subscription fifty-percent promotion and additional storage. Confirm renewal, credit expiry and storage persistence. It explicitly says all orders are nonrefundable.
sections.zh: Starter 称 $0.50 试用额度及 50GB 私有存储，不是持续免费 GPU。Essential $6.98/$13.95、月 $12 额度，Advanced $13.48/$26.95、月 $25，标首次半价及额外存储。需核续费、额度到期及存储持续，页面明确所有订单不退。

sections.title_en: Check each model’s terms before commercial output
sections.title_zh: 商用前核每个模型条款
sections.en: MimicPC’s open-source-platform headline does not establish a source license for the service or unrestricted rights in every hosted model. Review the actual application/model license and training-data permissions. No app, GPU session, custom node, LoRA training, export or billing meter was tested; storage durability and recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 开源平台标题不建立服务源码许可，也不赋予所有模型无限权利。需核实际应用/模型许可及训练数据授权。本文未测应用、GPU、节点、LoRA、导出或计费，存储持久及恢复未核。

research_gaps: No hosted application, compute meter, training, node, storage or recovery tested.
Platform/model licensing, idle/session billing, credit expiry and self-hosted platform source unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
